content: Customer Kunal Mehta calls insurance agent Ravi Menon to confirm the cancellation and zero-balance status of his previous health policy (HP-123456) and requests a re-sent cancellation confirmation and claim-history summary. They also discuss transitioning to a new group health plan through his new employer without a coverage gap, waiving the waiting period, bundling a dental rider with a 5% discount, and avoiding the $25 admin fee by enrolling through the employer portal. The agent agrees to email the enrollment form and quote.

action_items: Send dental rider quote and short enrollment form via email
Customer to sign and return the enrollment form
